image_description: A close-up view of a slender, reddish-brown snake coiled on a bed of green moss. The snake has a smooth, glossy texture and uniform coloration. The head is visible in the lower left, appearing small and rounded, blending into the body. The tail end is not clearly isolated but appears to taper naturally.
